defective_pattern: Applying bold formatting to table captions in markdown and omitting explicit text justification tags in OpenXML for Persian narrative paragraphs.
why_defective: Violates APA 7th Edition standards which dictate that the table number is bold, but the table title/caption must be italicized or plain text, not bold. Furthermore, Persian academic typography strictly requires full justification (<w:jc w:val='both'/>).
observed_symptoms: Table captions enclosed in bold markdown (e.g., **جدول...**).
Persian text in DOCX deliverables appears jagged because default alignment is applied instead of 'both' (justified).
corrective_remedy: Format table captions without bolding (only bold the table number). For DOCX generation, always explicitly include <w:jc w:val='both'/> within the <w:pPr> element of narrative paragraphs.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Deterministic regex pattern matching bolded table captions in markdown.
